raw.details:
AI Kaushal Hackathon 2026 is a state-level AI hackathon organised by InMobi with the Department of IT & Electronics, Government of Uttar Pradesh, and hosted at IIIT Lucknow. Teams build practical AI solutions for real public-sector problem statements, and the best solutions may be deployed in a UP Government department.

At a Glance

Prize Pool ₹5,00,000 (₹1,00,000 to each of the Top 5 teams)
Format Online idea submission, then a 24-hour in-person hackathon
Venue IIIT Lucknow
Dates 8 and 9 December 2026
Team Size 1 to 4 members
Open To Students, professionals and start-ups residing in Uttar Pradesh
Entry Fee Free

Why Participate

  • ₹1,00,000 cash prize for each of the Top 5 teams
  • Real-world impact: the best solutions may be deployed in a UP Government department
  • Paid internships: students from top-performing teams become eligible
  • Tech Leadership Connect: an invite-only session for top teams with leading tech minds
  • Recognition: winner certificates and features on InMobi's social media channels
  • For every shortlisted participant: goodies and a participation certificate

Eligibility

Open to anyone currently residing in Uttar Pradesh (a domicile certificate is not required) who is one of the following:

Category Proof required
Student at a college or university in UP Valid Student ID
Professional at a company with an office in UP Employee ID or employment proof
Start-up with a registered office in UP GST registration, Startup India recognition or incorporation document

Use Cases

Pick one of the 17 use cases. Full details are on the official website.

Category Use case
Agriculture 1. Farmer Market Price Intelligence - Mandi Advisory
Education 2. Job Readiness & Vocational Interview Coach
Education 3. Unified Internship Platform
Employment 4. AI-Powered Matching for Rojgar Sangam
Governance 5. Vernacular Citizen Services Assistant
Governance 6. Universal Intake, Triage & Routing Engine
Healthcare 7. Predictive Disease Outbreak Surveillance
Healthcare 8. Child Nutrition & At-Risk Detection for Anganwadi Workers
Healthcare 9. Affordable Medicine Discovery
Labour 10. AI Scheme Navigator for Construction Workers
Livelihoods 11. Livelihood & Micro-Enterprise Growth Assistant
Tourism 12. Investment Facilitation & Approval Processes
Tourism 13. Grievance Redressal System
Tourism 14. LLM-Powered Project Monitoring & Decision Support System
Youth Affairs & Sports 15. AI Playground and Sports Facility Optimizer
Youth Affairs & Sports 16. AI Youth Volunteer and Community Project Matcher
Youth Affairs & Sports 17. AI Athlete and Coach Performance Monitoring

How It Works

  • Register on Unstop (by 27 Nov): register your team of 1 to 4 members on this page.
  • Submit your idea on the InMobi portal (by 27 Nov): on the official InMobi AI Kaushal portal, choose a use case and answer five short questions. No prototype is needed. Then tick the one-time confirmation in the "Idea Submission on InMobi Portal" round here on Unstop.
  • Shortlisting (27 Nov-1 Dec): the Expert Panel reviews every entry and announces the shortlisted teams.
  • 24-hour hackathon (8 to 9 Dec): shortlisted teams build their MVP at IIIT Lucknow with mentor support.
  • Final demos (9 Dec): top MVPs pitch live to industry leaders and senior government officials.

Judging Criteria

Idea Shortlisting: Relevance to the use case · Innovation & uniqueness · Solution approach & technical soundness · Feasibility & clarity of scope

Hackathon Build: Working solution & completeness · Technical execution & architecture · Innovation & differentiation · Outcome against the use case · Scalability & path to production · Responsible AI implementation

At the Hackathon

  • Provided: OpenAI/Gemini AI credits, workspace and campus Wi-Fi, a mentor for each team, meals and refreshments, and rest areas
  • Bring: your laptop, charger and valid ID or eligibility proof
  • Arrange yourself: travel to Lucknow and accommodation (the hackathon runs overnight)
  • Final submission: a 3 to 5 minute video covering your solution, architecture and a live prototype demo, plus optional slides

Jury

  • Kumar Vineet, IAS: Special Secretary, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
  • Alok Kumar, IAS: Principal Secretary, Planning & Programme Implementation and IT & Electronics Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
  • Prof. Deepak Singh: Dean Research, IIIT Lucknow
  • Mohit Saxena: Co-founder & CTO, InMobi
  • Dr. Subi Chaturvedi: Global SVP, Chief Corporate Affairs & Public Policy Officer, InMobi Group
  • Srikanth Sundarrajan: Partner Engineer II, InMobi

Organisers & Partners

Organised by InMobi, with the Department of IT & Electronics, Government of Uttar Pradesh
Conceived & Curated by Dr. Subi Chaturvedi, InMobi Group
Technology Partner OpenAI
Academic Partner IIIT Lucknow
Outreach Partners Google Developers Group HBTU
Android Lucknow
Cyber Intelligence Community Lucknow
CNCG Lucknow
Google Developer Group IIIT Allahabad
GDG Kanpur
Lucknow AI Labs | UPAI Labs
Unstop Listing by IIIT Lucknow, with IIITL Axios and IIITL CREATE

Good to Know

  • Ideas are submitted only on the official InMobi AI Kaushal portal. You should receive a confirmation email from InMobi after submitting, and only ideas submitted there are evaluated.
  • A maximum of one use case will be shortlisted per team.
  • Queries: hackathon@inmobi.com
